1.question: What is my own nature?
1.plain: You are one free, self-shining light of awareness. The world you take for real is only its reflection; nothing actually covers it.
1.text_quote: The freedom belonging to that light is its energy of bliss

alternates.quote: self-luminous and it shines with reference to none
This universe is composed solely of consciousness
Bliss is Brahman which abides in the body

2.question: Why don't I see it right now?
2.plain: Because your own thinking keeps insisting you are a limited person in a limited world - and until grace touches you, that story keeps winning.
2.text_quote: immediately attains liberation while still living
2.note: primary picked by agent reading 2026-10-29; A-graders for Q2: TS11.2, TS11.3

3.question: What keeps me bound?
3.plain: Your own thought keeps it going: every time you take yourself to be the doer in a world of your own, another veil weaves - of time, knowledge, wanting and effort - over a freedom that never left.
3.text_quote: then it is called a bound soul

alternates.quote: Upon perfect attainment of a firm conviction contrary

4.question: How do I see this?
4.plain: There are four ways in, and each one comes to fit the person: some are freed at a single hearing, some by seeing all this as reflection, some by true thought replacing old thought, some by breath, body and practice.
4.text_quote: Could the thousand-rayed sun be illuminated by a jar

alternates.quote: That which cannot shine separately, but shines when merged with others
Yoga is offering of all entities to the Lord
One should meditate in the blissful and luminous abode

4.note: primary picked by agent reading 2026-10-29; A-graders for Q4: TS2.1, TS3.1
4.plain_note: drafted by agent on owner instruction 2026-10-29; subject-first, no source-language terms, every clause traceable to the text span; OWNER SIGN-OFF PENDING

5.question: How do I practice?
5.plain: It starts with breath: rest in your breathing and time itself shows up as one breath. Then the bath, the offering and the mantra are only real as the inner absorption they point to - kept up daily, not done once.

alternates.quote: One should meditate in the blissful and luminous abode
Yoga is offering of all entities to the Lord
the very essence of all entities, is called worship
the net of all the bonds has dissolved

6.question: What remains after death?
6.plain: Nothing ends at death for anyone grace has touched - they can be lifted from anywhere, even from hell. The knower's own death changes nothing: what remains is what was always so, and only grace decides the rest.
6.text_quote: Siva is by nature inclined to show grace
